Multimedia photographic exhibition on 1971 begins tomorrow
2016-03-18T00:00:00+06:00 | Unb, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/news/multimedia-photographic-exhibition-1971-begins-tomorrow-1043443

A weeklong multimedia photographic exhibition titled "1971: Emergence of a Nation" will begin tomorrow at the National Art Gallery, Shilpakala Academy in the capital.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host the event that will continue until March 26.

Foreign Minister AH Mahmood Ali will inaugurate the event at 4:00pm. Ministers, MPs, and diplomats will attend the event.
